# Segment sitemap into core/archive index and emit llms-full.txt and llms-all.txt

## Problem

After `#20089` (`PR #20097`) excluded the `19,436` raw GitHub archive routes (`tickets`, `pull-requests`, `discussions`) from the default `sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` (`469` core URLs vs `19,905` total; `40 KB` vs `1.6 MB`), two downstream consumer and observability requirements need a segmented Sitemap Index and tiered `llms-*.txt` hierarchy:

1. **Middleware prerender route source + Search Console per-child coverage (`sitemap.xml`):** While every ticket page sidebar already links the archive for crawler discovery (`neomjs/middleware-v2#35` / `#36`), `neomjs/middleware-v2`'s `BuildService#fetchDynamicRoutes` derives its prerender route set from `sitemap.xml`. Turning `sitemap.xml` into a `<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` over `sitemap-core.xml` (`469` core URLs) and `sitemap-archive.xml` (`19,436` archive URLs) preserves the full `19,905` route set for `middleware-v2` (once `neomjs/middleware-v2#40` expands `<sitemapindex>`) while giving per-child coverage reporting in Google Search Console.
2. **Tiered LLM context consumption (`llms.txt` vs `llms-full.txt` vs `llms-all.txt`):** Following the `llmstxt.org` specification and the Map vs. World Atlas paradigm (`ADR 0007`), AI coding assistants need:
   - `llms.txt` (~40 KB Map): Curated index of core documentation, blog posts, release notes, and examples, with an `## Optional` section pointing to deeper tiers.
   - `llms-full.txt` (~1.67 MB / ~427k tokens Core Documentation Atlas): Concatenated full Markdown prose of all `124` leaf guides in `learn/tree.json` (`143` nodes minus `19` parent folders) in a single file for 1M-token context-window ingestion without N+1 fetches.
   - `llms-all.txt` (~1.26 MB Exhaustive Archive Index): Complete route index including all `19,436` ticket, PR, and discussion `/raw/` links for deep forensic lookup.
3. **Distribution copy list (`buildScripts/docs/seo/copy.mjs`):** `SEO_FILES` only copies `['robots.txt', 'llms.txt', 'sitemap.xml']` into `dist/{development,esm,production}/apps/portal/`, omitting the segmented sitemaps and tiered `llms-*.txt` files.

## Intended Outcome

1. **`buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`:**
   - Support `onlyArchives` filtering so `getSitemapXml` can emit either the core `<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` (`includeArchives: false`) or the archive-only `<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` (`onlyArchives: true`, containing `tickets`, `pull-requests`, and `discussions`).
   - Export `getSitemapIndexXml({ baseUrl, sitemaps })` emitting a valid `<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` referencing `sitemap-core.xml` and `sitemap-archive.xml` (with their newest `<lastmod>` when available).
   - Export `getLlmsFullTxt({ baseUrl, basePath })` that walks the `124` leaf `learn/tree.json` guide routes and concatenates their Markdown content with canonical source URL headers.
   - Include a standard `## Optional` section in the curated `getLlmsTxt({ includeArchives: false })` output linking to `llms-full.txt` and `llms-all.txt`.
2. **`buildScripts/docs/rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`:**
   - Generate and write `sitemap.xml` (index), `sitemap-core.xml`, `sitemap-archive.xml`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `llms-all.txt` under `apps/portal/`.
3. **`buildScripts/docs/seo/copy.mjs`:**
   - Copy `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `llms-all.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `sitemap-core.xml`, and `sitemap-archive.xml` into `dist/*/apps/portal/`.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface / Artifact | Producer | Consumers | Contract / Deploy Order |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sitemap.xml` | `getSitemapIndexXml` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`) via `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` | 1. `neomjs/middleware-v2` `BuildService#fetchDynamicRoutes` (`neomjs/middleware-v2#40`)<br>2. `neomjs/pages` `buildScripts/enhanceSeo.mjs` (`neomjs/pages#54`)<br>3. Search engine crawlers via `robots.txt` | Root element changes from `<urlset>` to `<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">`. **Deploy order:** `neomjs/middleware-v2#40` MUST be deployed before any `neomjs/pages` deploy ships a `neomjs/neo` build with `#20102` (pre-`#40` middleware matches only `<url>` blocks and would silently resolve `0` routes). |
| `sitemap-core.xml` & `sitemap-archive.xml` | `getSitemapXml` (`includeArchives: false` / `onlyArchives: true`) via `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` | 1. `sitemap.xml` `<sitemapindex>`<br>2. `neomjs/middleware-v2#40` child-sitemap fetcher<br>3. `neomjs/pages#54` `enhanceSeo.mjs` (`OPTIONAL_SEO_FILES`) | Valid `<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` documents (`469` core URLs in `sitemap-core.xml`; `19,436` archive URLs in `sitemap-archive.xml`). |
| `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `llms-all.txt` | `getLlmsTxt` & `getLlmsFullTxt` via `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs` | 1. `neomjs/pages#54` `enhanceSeo.mjs`<br>2. LLM/agent consumers (`llmstxt.org` discovery)<br>3. `/raw/` markdown middleware (`neomjs/middleware-v2#41` tracks `/raw/` coverage for learn/PR/discussion links) | `llms.txt` (~40 KB curated Map) includes `## Optional` pointing to `llms-full.txt` (`124` leaf guides, ~1.67 MB / ~427k tokens) and `llms-all.txt` (`19,904` links, ~1.26 MB). |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `getSitemapXml` supports `onlyArchives: true` (emitting only `tickets`, `pull-requests`, and `discussions` routes) and `includeArchives: false` (emitting only core routes) using the standard `http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9` XML namespace.
- [ ] `getSitemapIndexXml` emits a valid `<sitemapindex xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">` pointing to `sitemap-core.xml` and `sitemap-archive.xml`, deriving each child entry's `<lastmod>` from the newest `<lastmod>` in that child `<urlset>` when present.
- [ ] `getLlmsTxt({ includeArchives: false })` includes an `## Optional` section linking to `llms-full.txt` and `llms-all.txt`.
- [ ] `getLlmsFullTxt` concatenates the Markdown prose of all `124` leaf `learn/tree.json` guides with `# [Title](url)` headers.
- [ ] `rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo` writes `sitemap.xml`, `sitemap-core.xml`, `sitemap-archive.xml`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, and `llms-all.txt`, and `buildScripts/docs/seo/copy.mjs` includes all 7 SEO/LLM files in `SEO_FILES`.
- [ ] Unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/RebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.spec.mjs` verify the segmented sitemaps, sitemap index, `llms-full.txt`, `llms-all.txt`, and rebuild pipeline.
